description: Uploads a file into the project from a public URL (additive). Uses the Upload API host with the public key. Returns { type: "token", token } for async ingestion (poll separately) or the file info. Upload API: POST /from_url/.

source_url.description: Public URL of the file to ingest.

store.description: Store the file: "1" = store, "0" = don't store, "auto" = project default. Default "auto".

name: uploadcare_upload_from_url
title: Upload file from URL
